summary.intent: Land a set of stacked PRs for the tsrs/caliper converter (construct-suite CI relanding, checker-lane/parity gates, converter memo cost fix) and continue with slice 3 (React families, Omit chains, own members).
summary.outcome: The memo fix landed as draft PR #399 (round trips back to 4,874, 628 to 546 ms, output byte-identical, CI green except Entire Gates pending approval). Slice 3 was started in a worker on feat/react-families stacked on #399; nothing has merged since #394 and #397/#398/#399 await user approval.

repo: Converter memo in crates/semantic/src/convert.rs is keyed by (type handle, depth); each entry records the enclosing-instantiation handles it asked about (found and absent) and is reused only if the context matches on all of them (Entry::holds_in).
Absent answers must be recorded in memo entries, not only back-reference hits; mutation testing showed recording only hits fails the soundness test.
Concurrent tasks race on the memo, so round trips on the chakra project vary slightly run to run (8,060 to 8,079) while output stays identical.
The measured chakra project lives at /tmp/claude-501/spike/proj/chakra, not fixtures/chakra.
Checker lane (construct:checker) has 212 rows: 203 green and 9 documented gaps; construct:parity is 212 identical.
Slice 3 targets regression rows react/13, react/29, react/34 and react/07; react/03, 04, 05 (ReactElement collapse kept by decision), react/29-key and objects/23-symbol-keyed stay documented gaps.
getBaseTypes is not yet called by the converter; slice 3 will use it to build named layers for dependency and lib bases.
Merge order for open PRs is #398, then #397, then #399; #397 and #398 share a one-line needs: list edit in ci.yml.
Entire Gates failing or pending on PRs means awaiting approval, not a real failure.
Rule from the #389 incident: after a parent PR merges, retarget the child PR before it merges.

code.finding: Counting test a_type_many_types_enclose_is_converted_once fails on main (1,211 round trips vs bound 300) and passes on the fix (274); the soundness test is a guard that passes on main but fails under the hit-only mutation.

workflow: Verify perf changes with interleaved runs and medians at low load; earlier runs at load 13 and 52 were untrustworthy.
Use mutation checks to prove a soundness test actually guards the invariant.
Run gates in a clean-room worktree and read exit statuses explicitly.
Stack dependent PRs with --base on the parent branch, using signed merge commits with no rebase or force-push.
Subagent task notifications can repeat for the same report; treat them as stop notices, not new instructions.

friction: A slice-1 subagent died with 'Login expired' (authentication_failed) after finishing its work; /login is needed if new agents fail this way.
Repeated task-notifications from the memo worker duplicated an already delivered report.
Entire Gates remains pending/failing on all open PRs until the user approves, blocking merges.
The user had not chosen between stacking slice 3 on #399 or waiting, so the assistant picked the stacked route by default.
open_items: User approvals needed for #398, #397, #399, and review of #396 (release bot's version PR).
Slice 3 worker (feat/react-families) is running and its results are not yet seen.
After #397 merges, update checker-expectations for rows flipped by slice 3.
After #398 merges, delete remote branches feat/construct-suite and perf/cycles-by-structure.
Memory cost of the memo bookkeeping beyond measured RSS is unverified.
